name: ShaderField
label: Shader field
description: An ambient WebGL2 field of soft light sources that sample colour tokens, with a reported fallback status.

props.name: params
props.description:
Field parameters, merged over the shipped defaults, so passing one
property changes one thing. Changing them never rebuilds the GL state.

props.name: blobs
props.description:
The light sources. Defaults to an eight-source composition: six on the
ambient tokens (`--color-ambient-*`, which follow the core accents unless a
theme re-points them) and two on surface tokens. Fewer than `BLOB_COUNT` entries is fine — unused slots park
off-field; more are ignored, because the shader's uniform arrays are
fixed-size.
props.defaultExpression:
[
  { token: "--color-ambient-1", size: 0.45, cx: 0.175, cy: 0.125, period: 18, phase: 0, weight: 1 },
  { token: "--color-ambient-2", size: 0.55, cx: 0.125, cy: 0.125, period: 16, phase: 1, weight: 1 },
  { token: "--color-ambient-3", size: 0.9, cx: 0.35, cy: 0.25, period: 22, phase: 0.5, weight: 1 },
  { token: "--color-bg-container-secondary", size: 0.55, cx: 0.025, cy: 0.075, period: 14, phase: 1.5, weight: 1 },
  { token: "--color-ambient-4", size: 0.55, cx: -0.125, cy: 0.475, period: 17, phase: 0.8, weight: 1 },
  { token: "--color-ambient-5", size: 0.48, cx: 0.39, cy: -0.26, period: 19, phase: 0.3, weight: 1 },
  { token: "--color-ambient-6", size: 0.3, cx: 0.35, cy: 0.3, period: 15, phase: 1.2, weight: 1 },
  { token: "--color-core-ui-secondary", size: 0.75, cx: -0.125, cy: -0.025, period: 20, phase: 0.7, weight: 1 },
]

props.name: enabled
props.description:
False keeps WebGL entirely unmounted and reports `unavailable`, so the
caller's fallback is the whole background. This is the kill switch: a
config lever, or an A/B against the fallback.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description:
Called whenever the renderer's status changes. Drive the fallback layer's
visibility from this — the component deliberately does not own one, since
what to paint instead is a design decision, not a rendering one.

ShaderBlob.description:
One light source in the field.

The coordinate space is the shader's (see field.glsl): origin at the
container centre, one unit = container width, y running downward. Centres
are constants — nothing here is recomputed on resize.

ShaderFieldStatus.description:
How the renderer has resolved.

`pending` is the one that matters to a caller: the context is still coming
up, so neither the field nor a fallback should be painted yet — showing a
fallback here and swapping it a frame later reads as two backgrounds loading
in sequence.

ShaderParams.description: The eight tuneable properties of the field.
